description: This file declares the `DbusMgr` class within the `WPEFramework::Plugin` namespace. The class provides methods to access various NetworkManager-related D-Bus proxies and connection objects, facilitating network management operations over D-Bus.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A class providing access to NetworkManager D-Bus proxies and connections, used for managing network interfaces and settings via D-Bus.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for the main NetworkManager object.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for NetworkManager settings.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsConnectionProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for a specific NetworkManager connection, given its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDeviceProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for a network device, given its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerWirelessProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for Wireless device properties, given its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for IPv4 configuration, given its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for IPv6 configuration, given its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerActiveConnProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for an active connection, given its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerAccessPointProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for access point properties, given its path.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the GDBusConnection object used for D-Bus communication.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerPropertyProxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for device properties, given its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for DHCPv4 configuration, given its path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the GDBusProxy for DHCPv6 configuration, given its path.
